title: Grateful Dead Live at The Spectrum on 1973-09-21
lineage: Akai GX636 direct tape head output  > Bottlehead tube tape pre w/a pair of Telefunken tubes circa 1960  > Apogee Mini Me 24/96  > Apogee Mini DAC monitoring and mastering  > FLAC
source: most likely MR > R @3 & 3/4 ips - dub of Jerry's reel left at a girlfriends house done by Will Boswell was done back in the Spring of '79

ai_review.summary: Excellent 9/21/73 Spectrum show with superb Truckin' > The Other One > Wharf Rat sequence captured on a crystal‑clear soundboard recording.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about this chilly September night, highlighting the smoking Truckin'/The Other One/Wharf Rat medley, a tasty Weather Report‑style jam in The Other One, and a horn‑filled Casey Jones encore. The soundboard source is praised for its clarity and the legendary 1973 Spectrum sound system, making the performance both musically and technically delightful.

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviews are highly positive (5, 4, 5 stars) praising both the musical performance and the recording quality; no criticisms were noted.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers describe the sound as crystal‑clear with an amazing 1973 system, comparable to the Wall of Sound; no dropouts or muddiness reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Set order was corrected (second set does not start with Let Me Sing Your Blues Away), delivering a smooth, magical flow typical of the Spectrum era.
